scheme_name: Summit Active Asset Allocator Long-Short Fund
fund_name: Summit Active Asset Allocator Long-Short Fund
category: Hybrid Investment Strategies - Active Asset Allocator Long-Short Fund
scheme_objective:
To generate income by actively seeking arbitrage opportunities and investing across multiple
asset classes, such as equity & equity related instruments, fixed income instruments and
commodity derivatives, while taking limited short exposure on permitted instruments through
derivatives to optimize returns and manage risk.

There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Investment strategy will be achieved.

investment_limits.minimum_application_amount: 10,00,000 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter.

expenses_and_loads.exit_load:
For each purchase of units through Lumpsum / switch-in / Systematic Investment Plan (SIP),
Systematic Transfer Plan (STP), exit load will be as follows:

if units are redeemed/switched out on or before 30 days from the date of allotment: 0.50%
• if units are redeemed/switched-out after 30 days, but on or before 60 days from the date of
allotment: 0.25%
• if units are redeemed/switched-out after 60 days: Nil
• Switch between the Plans under the Investment Strategy: Nil
